Title: QC-Studio - A web-based quality control (QC) application for neuroimaging data.
Project Description:
🎯 Goals

  • Create an interactive web app to visualize neuroimaging data - raw and processed!
  • Support multiple image types: 3D MRI (NIfTI), 2D image montages, and IQM metrics
  • Enable structured quality control ratings through a clean, intuitive interface
Goals for Brainhack Montreal:
• [ ] Gather user feedback 📋
  • [ ] Fix UI bugs 🐛
  • [ ] Add cool features 😎
Skills:
• Python 🐍
  • NiiVue / Streamlit (Optional) 💻
  • Interest in QC / Neuroanatomy / UI design 🧠
What will participants learn?:
• Neuroimaging QC workflows
  • Python based web-apps
  • The dark side of vibe coding
Data to use: Some sample data is provided in the repo.
